Q2What waits

You asked what waits on you to be orange and first. Today a form below the Block only flags its row, and an sNN not agreed adds an open-points line.

What shows first in Progress?

Why A: A form names the exact question; an open point is not asked yet.

Q3A Job's Tasks

s52's red question. Where things stand moved here from the Report (s52-D01), and the Report's Status listed every Task under its Job.

Does a Job list all its Tasks, or only one?

Why A: Where things stand stays whole; each Job folds by its heading.

Q4A Job's head

A Job's goal says what it builds, not which sNN gets it or what came out last. b16 ends each Work view with a link to its result in Report.

What does a Job say above its Tasks?

Why A: It links the Job to its delivery; the thing itself shows in Report.

Q5Its own Runs

The Block keeps its own runs/: forms not sent yet, answered forms, soft Runs. Today only its forms show, first in Work, whatever their state.

Where do the Block's own Runs show?

Why A: Waiting ones still go first; the rest is work, so it ends Work.
